# Ramp/Jet

> Ramp/Jet builds the systems owner-operated industrial companies run on when the owner isn't in
> the room: the website, the demand engine behind it, and the quoting, tracking and follow-up work
> that still runs on spreadsheets and memory.

Who it's for: owner-operated industrial companies, roughly $5-50M — machine shops, fabricators,
distributors, contract manufacturers, specialty suppliers. The defining condition is that sales,
quoting and customer knowledge still route through one or two people.

Scope: everything from the first search to the ERP. Ramp/Jet connects to what a company already
uses (QuickBooks, spreadsheets, the shared drive) and stops where the ERP begins. It does not
replace an ERP.

## Products

- **Rework** — the website. A professional site rebuilt in two days from the first call. Brand
  system, hosting and a quarterly inspection included. $2,000 one-time, plus an optional Maintain
  plan at $200/month.
- **Reach** — the demand engine. Every inquiry (web form, email, phone) captured, routed and
  followed up on a fixed schedule, with a weekly report. Billed monthly.
- **Run** — operations. One process at a time (quoting, job tracking, customer records) moved out
  of one person's head into a system the whole team can run. From $3,500 per project, fixed price,
  scoped first.
- **The Full Build** — all three, built in order on one work order.

## Not offered

ERP replacement, six-month rollouts, rip-and-replace migrations, "digital transformation"
programmes, or AI sold as the headline.
